title: Is the lab safe?
description:
Check a driver lab's setup before loading anything.

```
virtual machine:        yes
snapshot taken:         yes
test signing on (VM):   yes
host test signing:      no   (good: never on your main machine)
kernel debugger:        attached
-> ready to load the test driver
```
hints: Check the items in the order you would fix them: a machine, a snapshot, then signing and the debugger (lesson 1.02).
Return the first problem as the verdict, so the person fixes one thing at a time.
requirements: A `struct Lab` of `bool`s for each item in lesson 1.02.
Every required item must be true and the host must not have test signing on.
Print each line and a final verdict with the first problem to fix.
stretch: Add a check that the VM has no shared folders with write access to your real files.
